journey.name: Sport days
journey.description: A class trained away from the app goes on the plan and shows on the week. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: Verify that the app opens on the "Today" tab with "Nothing planned"
Tap the "+" on today's weekday row in "Routine"
In the "Add to plan" sheet, tap "Sport"
Verify that the sheet lists "BJJ", "Climbing", "Running" and "Something else", with "BJJ" picked
Verify that today's row shows a "BJJ class" chip with a pennant beside it
Verify that the "Routine" heading reads "Every week · 1 sport day"
Verify that "BJJ" is written under today on the week strip, whose bar is the short one of a rest day
Verify that "Up next · Today" shows "BJJ class" and "Counts toward your week"
